IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark brown hair in a
neat high bun, with face-framing strands, smiles
softly with glossy mauve lips. She wears a deep
oxblood satin high-neck top with full sleeves.
Behind her, blurred warm lights and a dark floral
arrangement fill the space. Her expression is
relaxed and warm. Soft, warm evening light, a
palette of oxblood, deep brown, and warm amber
highlights. Polished and understated, in the style of
an event candid portrait.
